verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's docs say to upload source maps for JavaScript projects to get readable stack traces, using the GlitchTip CLI to inject debug IDs and upload them. The CLI is officially documented with login, release and deploy commands that fit a CI pipeline. Sentry API compatibility suggests Sentry's tooling may also work, but this is only implied. Missing for 10: the CLI is labeled Beta, there is no explicit bundler-plugin (webpack/Vite) support, no CI-specific source-map upload walkthrough, and no independent or hands-on corroboration that symbolication works.
